mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_INGREDIENT_SHARE.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO ingredient_share ( share_id, author_id, title, content, status, view_count, share_type, location_text, available_from, available_until, max_recipients, exchange_note, share_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{share_id}, #{author_id}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status}, 0, #{share_type}, #{location_text}, TO_TIMESTAMP(#{available_from}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI'), TO_TIMESTAMP( #{available_until, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI' ), #{max_recipients}, #{exchange_note, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{share_status}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO share_item ( share_item_id, share_id, ingredient_id, quantity, unit, expires_on, item_note ) VALUES ( SEQ_SHARE_ITEM.NEXTVAL, #{share_id}, #{ingredient_id}, #{quantity}, #{unit}, TO_DATE(#{expires_on, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{item_note, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT s.share_id, s.author_id, s.title, s.content, s.share_type, s.location_text, TO_CHAR(s.available_from, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS available_from, TO_CHAR(s.available_until, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS available_until, s.max_recipients, s.exchange_note, s.share_status, TO_CHAR(s.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS created_at, s.view_count, m.name FROM ingredient_share s JOIN member m ON s.author_id = m.member_id WHERE s.status = 0 AND s.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.share_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT s.share_id, s.author_id, m.name, s.title, s.content, s.share_type, s.location_text, TO_CHAR(s.available_from, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS available_from, TO_CHAR(s.available_until, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS available_until, s.max_recipients, s.exchange_note, s.share_status, s.view_count, TO_CHAR(s.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS created_at, TO_CHAR(s.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updated_at FROM ingredient_share s JOIN member m ON s.author_id = m.member_id WHERE s.share_id = #{share_id} AND s.status = 0 AND s.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT si.share_item_id, si.share_id, si.ingredient_id, i.ingredient_name, si.quantity, si.unit, TO_CHAR(si.expires_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS expires_on, si.item_note FROM share_item si JOIN ingredient i ON si.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id WHERE si.share_id = #{share_id} ORDER BY si.share_item_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ingredient_share SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, share_type = #{share_type}, location_text = #{location_text}, available_from = TO_TIMESTAMP( #{available_from} , 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI'), available_until = TO_TIMESTAMP( #{available_until}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI'), max_recipients = #{max_recipients}, exchange_note = #{exchange_note, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE share_id = #{share_id} AND author_id = #{author_id} AND status = 0 AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT i.ingredient_id, i.ingredient_name, i.default_unit AS unit FROM ingredient i WHERE i.active_yn = 'Y' AND ( LOWER(i.ingredient_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ingredient_alias a WHERE a.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id AND a.active_yn = 'Y' AND LOWER(a.alias_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' ) ) ORDER BY i.ingredient_name, i.ingredient_id
SELECT i.ingredient_id, i.ingredient_name, i.default_unit AS unit FROM ingredient i WHERE i.active_yn = 'Y' AND i.ingredient_type = #{type} ORDER BY i.ingredient_name, i.ingredient_id
